resolved.title: 预处理指令
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Preprocessor Directives[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The C [b]preprocessor[/b] uses the [b]# directives[/b] to make substitutions in program source code before compilation. 
For example, the line [b]#include <stdio.h>[/b] is replaced by the contents of the stdio.h header file before a program is compiled.

Preprocessor directives and their uses:

[b]#include[/b] Including header files.

[b]#define, #undef[/b] Defining and undefining macros.

[b]#ifdef, #ifndef, #if, #else, #elif, #endif[/b] Conditional compilation.

[b]#pragma[/b] Implementation and compiler specific.

[b]#error, #warning[/b] Output an error or warning message An error halts compilation.
[note]Do NOT put a semicolon character at the end of a # directive.[/note]

content.text:
C预处理程序在编译之前使用`#`指令在程序源代码中进行替换。

例如，在编译程序之前，行`#include <stdio.h>`被`stdio.h`头文件的内容替换。

预处理程序指令及其用法：

- `#include` 包括头文件。

- `#define`，`#undef` 定义和取消定义宏。

- `#ifdef`，`#ifndef`，`#if`，`#else`，`#elif`，`#endif`条件编译。

- `#pragma` 用于指示编译器完成一些特定的动作

- `#error`，`#warning` 输出错误或警告消息错误停止编译。

resolved.question_text: 以下哪个预处理指令允许在源代码中包含头文件？
resolved.question_text_html: Which of the following preprocessor directives allows to include header files in the source code?

resolved.title: #include 指令
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The #include Directive[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The #include directive is for including [b]header files[/b] in a program. A header file declares a collection of functions and macros for a [b]library[/b], a term that comes from the way the collection of code can be reused. 

Some useful C libraries are:
[b]stdio[/b] input/output functions, including printf and file operations.
[b]stdlib[/b] memory management and other utilities
[b]string[/b] functions for handling strings
[b]errno[/b] errno global variable and error code macros
[b]math[/b] common mathematical functions
[b]time[/b] time/date utilities

Corresponding header files for the libraries end with [b].h[/b] by convention. The #include directive expects brackets <> around the header filename if the file should be searched for in the compiler include paths.

A [b]user-defined header file[/b] is also given the .h extension, but is referred to with quotation marks, as in "myutil.h". When quotation marks are used, the file is searched for in the source code directory.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="c" ]#include <stdio.h>
#include “myutil.h” [/code]
[note]Some developers use .hpp extension for header files.[/note]

resolved.title: #define 指令

content.text:
C语言中，可以用 `#define` 定义一个标识符来表示一个常量。

其特点是：定义的标识符不占内存，只是一个临时的符号，预编译后这个符号就不存在了。

预编译又叫预处理。预编译不是编译，而是编译前的处理。这个操作是在正式编译之前由系统自动完成的。

用 `#define` 定义标识符的一般形式为：

```c
#define  标识符  常量   //注意, 最后没有分号
```

`#define`又称宏定义，标识符为所定义的宏名，简称宏。标识符的命名规则与前面讲的变量的命名规则是一样的。`#define` 的功能是将标识符定义为其后的常量。一经定义，程序中就可以直接用标识符来表示这个常量。

例如：

The #define directive is used to create object-like macros for constants based on values or expressions. #define can also be used to create function-like macros with arguments that will be replaced by the preprocessor.

Be cautious with function-like definitions. Keep in mind that the preprocessor does a direct replacement without any calculations, which can lead to unexpected results, as demonstrated with the following program:

#define指令用于为基于值或表达式的常量创建类似对象的宏。 #define也可以用来创建类似函数的宏，其参数将被预处理程序替换。

对类函数的定义要谨慎。请记住，预处理器会在不进行任何计算的情况下进行直接替换，这可能会导致意想不到的结果，正如下面的程序所演示的那样。

content.text:
在编译之前，预处理程序会对每个宏标识符进行扩展。在这种情况下，**PI**的每一次出现都被替换为3.14，**AREA**(arg)被替换为`PI*arg*arg`的表达。发送给编译器的最终代码将已经有了常量值。

这不是我们可能期望的! 然而，如果你考虑到`#define`严格通过替换文本来工作，你会看到`AREA(radius+1)`变成`PI*radius+1*radius+1`，也就是`3.14*2+1*2+1`。

解决这个问题的办法是将每个参数用圆括号`()`括起来，以获得正确的运算顺序。

resolved.title: 格式化预处理指令
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Formatting Preprocessor Directives[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

When using preprocessor directives, the [b]#[/b] must be the first character on a line. But there can be any amount of white space before # and between the # and the directive.

If a # directive is lengthy, you can use the [b]\[/b] [b]continuation character[/b] to extend the definition over more than one line.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="c" codeId="2211"]#define VERY_LONG_CONSTANT [b]\[/b]
23.678901

#define MAX 100
#define MIN 0
#    define SQUARE(x) [b]\[/b]
    x*x [/code]
[note]There can be any amount of white space before # and between the # and the directive.[/note]
